title: Compare first
story: I want to compare markets before I connect a wallet.
acceptance: Show available collateral and utilization. Do not require a wallet to browse.

title: Know the swap
story: I want to know what I pay and the minimum I receive.
acceptance: Name the actual tokens. Show minimum received, fee and quote state before signing.

title: Borrow with context
story: I want to see how new debt changes my health.
acceptance: Separate the loan from LP shares. Show collateral, debt and health before and after.

title: Supply liquidity
story: I want to add liquidity without confusing it with my loan.
acceptance: Switch the summary and form together. Distinguish marked LP value from available withdrawal cash.

title: Inspect my channel
story: I want to see my range, both token amounts and each collectible amount.
acceptance: Range status describes this position. Do not call every collectible amount a fee.

title: Recover safely
story: I want to know what failed and how to continue.
acceptance: Show expired, disconnected and partial-failure states. Never repeat a confirmed approval automatically.

title: Check settlement
story: I want to check the batch before I run settlement.
acceptance: Show source and completeness. Keep execution disabled when a complete, balanced batch is unavailable.
